simplesounds.option.followVisuals.toolti:
Use the Simple Visuals intensity when
available. Effect overrides take priority;
otherwise your own level applies. Client
only. Default: true.

simplesounds.guide.page.14.title: Local cosmetic safety
simplesounds.guide.page.14: No packets, server gameplay, entities, inventory changes or remote player scans. At most four sounds per tick, two per player and eight budgeted players; excess requests are dropped.
simplesounds.guide.page.15.title: Local cosmetic safety
simplesounds.guide.page.15: World changes clear all history. An effective Off level or zero limits disable playback; effect overrides take priority over global levels. Vanilla sound assets and subtitles are reused; no bundled audio.
simplesounds.guide.page.16.title: Settings
simplesounds.guide.page.16: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
